// Uses of Lightbox: screens of the first corpus and blocks of the notation reference that write it,
// taken by tool/dictionary_closure.dart --harvest (the most shapes of it first). Do not edit: run it again.
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b09/answers/scope-trace.txt ### Saved traces
state sel=0
state traces=[{"name":"Sine 1.2 kHz","when":"Today 09:41","pp":"6.4 V","url":"https://example.com/t1.png"},{"name":"Square 600 Hz","when":"Today 09:12","pp":"3.0 V","url":"https://example.com/t2.png"},{"name":"Power-on glitch","when":"Yesterday","pp":"5.1 V","url":"https://example.com/t3.png"}]
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Wavepost" icon="graphic_eq"
    NavItem "Scope" icon="monitor_heart" onTap={go scope}
    NavItem "Measure" icon="straighten" onTap={go measure}
    NavItem "Saved traces" icon="photo_library" badge="3" selected={true}
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Saved traces" level=1
      Button.outline "Open scope" onTap={go scope}
    Column pad=24 gap=16
      Grid cols=3 gap=16
        each t in traces
          Card gap=8
            Image "{t.url}" h=140 onTap={sel=index; open zoom}
            Text.strong "{t.name}"
            Text.muted "{t.when} - {t.pp} pk-pk"
            Row gap=8
              IconButton "download" tooltip="Download" onTap={download t.url}
              IconButton "delete" tooltip="Delete" onTap={traces=removeAt(traces,index); toast "Deleted"}
  Lightbox#zoom photos={map(traces,t=>t.url)} @sel
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b09/answers/company-timeline.txt ### Event story
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Chronicle" icon="timeline"
    NavItem "Timeline" icon="timeline" onTap={go timeline}
    NavItem "Play mode" icon="play_circle" onTap={go play-mode}
    Spacer grow
  Main
    Nav
      Row gap=8
        IconButton "arrow_back" tooltip="Back to the timeline" onTap={go timeline}
        Heading "Series A, $12M" level=1
      Row gap=8
        Badge.warning "Money"
        Badge.neutral "2014"
    Column pad=24 gap=16 scroll
      Image "https://images.chronicle.example/seriesa.jpg" h=240 onTap={open zoom}
      Row gap=24 top
        Column grow gap=12
          Text.caption "March 4, 2014"
          Text.body "Led by Northgate Capital, the round funds the first real factory line. Headcount grew from 24 to 40 within the year, and the team moved out of the garage for good."
          Text.fieldLabel "Related events"
          Row gap=8 wrap
            Chip "First product ships, 2011" onTap={go timeline}
            Chip "Berlin office opens, 2018" onTap={go timeline}
          Link "Read the announcement" href="https://chronicle.example/news/series-a"
        Card w=300 gap=8
          Text.strong "Headcount that year"
          Sparkline values=[9,24,40,75]
          Text.caption "24 to 40 people"
  Lightbox#zoom "https://images.chronicle.example/seriesa.jpg" "The Series A signing, March 2014"
